summary.text: Tim Roberts is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee, Chattanooga, in 2016.

paragraphs.text: Tim Roberts was a Democratic candidate for Tennessee House District 26 in 2022, receiving 13.6% of the vote in the Democratic primary.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a stay-at-home dad with 20 years in the service industry and listed his key messages as marijuana legalization, protecting women's and LGBTQ+ rights, and infrastructure and jobs.
